name: Tidus Stair
summary: At Tidus Stair, two tauren shamans seek insight from the coastal water spirits. The broad stone terraces rise above the Merchant Coast southeast of Ratchet, sheltered beside the Great Sea.

sections.title: Steps to the Sea
sections.body: Waves break below Tidus Stair, where weathered stone terraces climb the coastal bluffs southeast of Ratchet. The Barrens are dry and dusty, and skirmishes trouble the region, but this stretch above the Merchant Coast is quiet. A modest hut shelters Islen Waterseer and Mahren Skyseer, two tauren who live far from the goblin trade docks. They fish, watch the horizon, and seek insight from the coastal water spirits.

aliases: how to get to tidus stair
faq.answer: Tidus Stair lies on the eastern coast of the Barrens, directly southeast of the goblin port of Ratchet. From its terraces, you look out over the waters of the Merchant Coast.
Islen Waterseer and Mahren Skyseer, two tauren, live in a simple seaside hut on the terraces. They fish and commune with nature.

faq.q: Why is Tidus Stair significant to shamans?
faq.answer: Horde shamans seeking mastery of water are guided across Kalimdor to find Islen Waterseer at Tidus Stair. Beside the open ocean, initiates learn to commune with the tides and seek pure waters to bind their water totem.

faq.q: Is Tidus Stair aligned with the Horde or neutral?
faq.answer: The tauren at Tidus Stair are loyal to the Horde and guide Horde shamans. The remote terraces lie beyond formal military borders.

angles.text: As a Horde shaman, you eventually journey down these coastal steps to seek Islen Waterseer during your trials to bind the water totem.
As a tauren, you can see in Islen Waterseer and Mahren Skyseer how tauren seers keep a spiritual vigil far beyond Mulgore's borders.
